Author: @digitalvideosolutionsdvsto9959

Dogs are people too
It’s amazing how domesticated dogs pick up on their owners energy & personality traits. Different compared to wolves, but even wolves have distinct personalities. They are raised in packs but they challenge one another for dominance & if there are differences in personality some will break off, live alone and find mates on their own. Wolves mate with one partner for life & will mourn the loss of their significant other. People could learn a thing or two from wolves. Self reliance, loyalty & survival of the fittest. Better to be alone than with the wrong people. Forcing yourself & adjudicating (compromising) your personality to fit in with people who aren’t right for you, but are convenient to be around, is no formula for long term happiness. That’s how you end up with regret looking back at your life as an old person. (Better to be alone than with the wrong people). Have hope & don’t commit yourself to life behind the computer screen / scrolling. Go out into the world & find your pack (or start your own). Touch grass. Be a good wolf 🐺 👍😊
